imgready Tools Developers Help

Privacy Policy

Last updated: April 27, 2026 · Operator: imgready (sole proprietorship operated by Jeffrey, California, USA) · Contact: hello@imgready.app

The short version. imgready is a browser-based tool. Your image files are processed entirely on your own device and never uploaded to our servers. We do not run accounts, do not collect names, addresses or payment information, and the only personal-data processors we share information with are Cloudflare (for hosting and the CDN), and a small number of CDNs that serve our compression libraries.

1. Who we are (data controller)

The data controller for the purposes of the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the controller/business for the California Consumer Privacy Act / CPRA (CCPA) is the operator of imgready.app, contactable at hello@imgready.app. We do not have an EU representative; if you are in the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland and prefer to contact us by post, email us first and we will provide a postal address.

2. What we process and why

2.1 Image files you load into the tool

When you drop, paste, or select an image file inside imgready, that file is decoded, processed and re-encoded entirely inside your web browser using JavaScript, WebAssembly and the HTML5 Canvas API. The file is held in your browser's RAM only for as long as you keep the tab open. It is never transmitted to imgready.app, Cloudflare, Google, or any other party. When you close or refresh the page, all image data is discarded.

Because we never receive your image files, we cannot delete, export or copy them on your behalf, there is nothing on our side to act on. You can clear them yourself by clicking "Clear All" or closing the tab.

2.2 Server logs (Cloudflare)

imgready is hosted on Cloudflare. When your browser requests a page, Cloudflare receives standard HTTP request information (IP address, user agent, requested URL, referrer, response code) and processes it briefly to deliver the response, defend against attacks and surface basic analytics. Cloudflare's processing is governed by Cloudflare's Privacy Policy. Lawful basis: GDPR Art. 6(1)(f): legitimate interest in operating, securing and analysing the service.

2.3 Advertising

There is none. imgready carried Google AdSense on a single page, the pattern generator, and that has been removed. No ad script loads on any page, no advertising cookies are set, and no ad network receives your IP address or device identifiers from this site. The tool is funded by the developer SDK and by voluntary contributions instead.

2.4 Compression libraries (CDN)

Some of the WebAssembly codecs that do the actual encoding are loaded from public CDNs rather than bundled into the page. These CDNs receive your IP address and user agent as part of fetching the file, the same way any web request does. We pin specific versions, and no image content is ever sent to them: they serve code to your browser, and the encoding then happens locally.

LibraryServed fromFetched when
@jsquash/webpesm.shYou output WebP
@jsquash/avifesm.shYou output AVIF
@jsquash/jpeg (MozJPEG)esm.shYou output JPG
@jsquash/oxipngesm.shYou output an optimised PNG
gifenccdn.jsdelivr.netYou output GIF

Two clarifications so this is not misleading. First, shortly after the page finishes loading we pre-fetch the codec for the output format you are most likely to use, so your first conversion is not slowed by a cold start. That means a request to esm.sh can happen before you convert anything. Second, once fetched, a codec is cached by our service worker, so repeat visits and offline use do not re-contact the CDN.

The remaining libraries are served from imgready's own origin and involve no third party at all: libheif (reading HEIC/HEIF), UPNG.js and pako (PNG encoding), and jszip (the "Download All" zip).

3. Cookies and similar technologies

imgready itself sets only one technical "cookie-like" mechanism: a small localStorage entry that remembers your night-mode preference, last-used output format and quality slider position. This data stays on your device and is never transmitted to us.

Third parties used on this site set their own cookies and similar identifiers:

Set byName (examples)PurposeTypical retention
imgready (this site)imgready_theme, imgready_q, imgready_fmt, imgready_nudge_shownRemember UI preferences. Local-only.Until you clear browser storage
Cloudflare__cf_bm, cf_clearanceBot management, security challenge30 minutes, 30 days

4. Consent (EU, EEA, UK, Switzerland)

We do not run a consent banner, because there are no non-essential cookies left to consent to.

5. California / CPRA: Do Not Sell or Share

We do not sell or share your personal information, and with advertising removed there is no longer any mechanism by which we could. The California Consumer Privacy Act, as amended by the California Privacy Rights Act, treats advertising cookies as a potential "sale" or "sharing" of personal information. imgready sets none. There are no ad networks, no advertising identifiers and no cross-context behavioural advertising on this site.

Nothing is required of you, and there is no opt-out to submit, because there is nothing to opt out of. Image data never leaves your device at all. If you want this confirmed in writing, email hello@imgready.app.

6. EU/UK rights (GDPR / UK GDPR)

If you are in the EU, EEA, UK or Switzerland you have the right to: access your personal data, correct it, delete it, restrict or object to processing, and data portability. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with your national data protection authority. Because we hold no account data and never receive your image files, the practical scope of these rights is limited to advertising / measurement cookies, and you can exercise those rights through Google's controls and the consent banner described above. For anything else, email hello@imgready.app.

7. Data retention

We do not store your image files at any point. Cloudflare retains its standard server logs for up to 30 days. The localStorage values we set on your browser remain until you clear them yourself.

8. International transfers

imgready operates from the United States. Cloudflare and Google process data in the US, the EU and other regions; both rely on the EU-US Data Privacy Framework and Standard Contractual Clauses for cross-border transfers from the EEA and UK to the US.

9. Children's privacy

imgready is not directed at children under 13 (or under 16 in the EU/UK). We do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If you believe a child has interacted with our advertising partners through our site, contact us and we will work with the relevant partner to remove the data.

10. Security

imgready is served over HTTPS only, sets HSTS, and loads its compression libraries from pinned versions on reputable CDNs. Because we never receive your image files, the most common image-tool risk, server-side breach of uploaded files, does not apply.

11. Changes to this policy

We will post a notice at the top of this page and update the "Last updated" date if we make material changes. The current version is always at imgready.app/privacy/.

12. Contact

Privacy or data-rights enquiries: hello@imgready.app · response within 30 days (45 days for CCPA requests).
